However AWS documentation states CloudTrail Lake will no longer be open to new customers starting May 31, 2026; for a new customer in October 2026, B may not be available. Flag as outdated unless the organization already enrolled.

wrongOptions.A: CloudWatch Logs Insights is not standard SQL and per-account trails add setup.
wrongOptions.B: Historical correct option: organization CloudTrail Lake event data store with SQL; service availability now limited for new customers.
wrongOptions.C: CloudTrail event history is not the required centralized SQL query interface.
wrongOptions.D: Per-account event data stores fragment central query capability and increase overhead.
